import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
lane=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
plan=dict(queries=["treewidth lower bound k-token graph symmetric power of a connected graph separator congestion Fabila-Monroy conjecture trees"],mode='standard',tool='WebSearch',target='362080',purpose='Second prior-art check for the token-graph treewidth conjecture under the alternative names symmetric power and separator or congestion lower bounds')
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'plans/search-2.json'],input=json.dumps(plan,indent=1)+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True)

if w.returncode: sys.exit(w.returncode)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'charge_search.py'),'plans/search-2.json'],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=str(lane))
print('charge exit',r.returncode);print(r.stdout);print(r.stderr)
sys.exit(r.returncode)
